notes.title: -Ghost Member-　ver1.1.0　2023/10/16
notes.content:
[b]Ghost Member　ver1.1.0　2023/10/16[/b]

Dear all who are interested in Ghost Member.

Ghost Member has been updated to ver1.1.0.
The contents of the update are as follows

[b]■Addition of Game Difficulty Levels[/b]
・Three difficulty levels are available: Story, Default, and Master.

[b]■Addition of free investigation mode[/b]
・You can select items in the clubroom and go to investigate.
・You can use more items and members of the club for successful deductions.

[b]■Addition of Achievements[/b]
・Eight new achievements have been added to the game.

[b]■TAKEO SUVIVORS updated to [2.0][/b]
・The game rules have been changed to be more survivor-like.

[b]■Added support for gamepad operation instructions.[/b]

[b]■Others[/b]
・Improved UI
・Improved stability
・Various adjustments to make it easier to play.
・End cards have been added after clearing the "true" game.

We hope you will continue to play.
